title: CoSE telemetry envelope (PROPOSAL v0.1, not adopted)
description: Common header for messages on cose/v1/devices/{device_uuid}/{leaf}. The body is the product's existing payload, validated by the product schema named in 'schema'. See CoSE_Ecosystem/docs/DATA_INTEGRATION_SPEC.md §3.2. Missing-value rule is an open decision.

schema.description: $id of the product body schema, e.g. https://cosecloud.com/schemas/xseed/telemetry/v1

device_uuid.description: Same UUID as in the topic path

seq.description: Monotonic per device; gaps mean dropped messages

mode.description: Device mode, e.g. recipe, override, safe

experiment_id.description: Optional join key to MIAPPE study metadata and the RO-Crate bundle

body.description: Product payload, unchanged from the product's own schema
